paper_style.palette_strategy: 白底、黑色轴框与浅灰 x/y 网格是共同底层语法；系列和机制颜色按图重新分配：Figure 1 用红/蓝表示 regime，Figures 2/6 用颜色表示 p，Figures 3/8/9/10 主要用颜色表示 N，Figures 4/5 用颜色表示理论对象。浅色 band 只出现在 Figure 8。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: Figure 1–8 由嵌入 RGB 栅格图组成（Figure 2/4/6 带 soft mask），原生 ppi 约 655–1289；Figure 9–10 没有 image XObject，图形路径、文字、marker 和 error bars 为 PDF 向量对象。页面本身以 200 dpi PNG 复核。
paper_style.style_consistency: 所有图保持白底、黑色坐标框和浅灰网格，但没有跨 Figure 的颜色合同。Figures 1–8 的 raster 图内字体较大且呈 sans-serif/mathtext 混合；Figures 9–10 的向量 small multiples 使用 PDF Roman/Computer Modern 字体且字号约 4.5–9 pt，视觉密度明显更高。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Overlap between the signal estimate and the true signal as a function of α for continuous BBP (Left) and discontinuous BBP (Right), with p = 2 and p∗ = 1.

color.semantic_mapping: 左 panel 的红色表示 a=0.7 continuous，右 panel 的蓝色表示 a=1.5 discontinuous；同色曲线为 m，dash-dot 线为 α_BBP。

figures.data_and_statistics: large-N analytic overlap m(α) for p=2 and p*=1. The left curve is zero until the continuous threshold and then rises continuously; the right curve jumps at the discontinuous threshold. No sampled uncertainty, repetitions, denominator, or failure value is encoded.
figures.evidence_relation: p.6 §4.1 caption “Overlap between the signal estimate and the true signal” and the following text define the λ*=λ− threshold, then connect sharp edge to continuous growth and smooth edge to discontinuous jump. Figure 1 is the theory-shape object; Appendix B p.20–22 derives the edge equations and Figure 5 visualizes their crossings.
design_strengths: The two regimes share the same m–α coordinates, making continuous growth and a finite jump directly comparable.
Solid response curves and dash-dot threshold lines separate the estimand from the critical value.
Caption states both transition regimes and the p,p* setting.
design_weaknesses: Curve-color semantics and the continuous/discontinuous labels are split between panel titles and legend rather than stated together in the caption.
The reference line touches the response at the transition, so a small raster rendering can obscure the crossing.
The analytic-only curves do not expose finite-N deviation or uncertainty.
figures.reusable_pattern: Pair mechanism regimes on identical axes, retain a shared response metric, and use a distinct reference-line style for the threshold; state the regime and parameter setting in the caption.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: αBBP as a function of a for p∗ = 1 and several values of p. The point at which the curves start increasing almost linearly is the point in which the transition becomes discontinuous. The dashed line shows αBBP(a) in the large overparametrization limit where the transition is always discontinuous. The insets show αBBP as a function of p for three fixed values of a. Here, red points indicate the transition is continuous, while blue points that it is discontinuous. The red crosses are estimates of α0, a ”finite-N” estimate of the transition described in section 4.2.

color.semantic_mapping: 主图颜色区分 p=1,2,3,4,∞；inset 圆点颜色区分 continuous/discontinuous，红色叉号表示 α0，黑色 dash-dot 表示 p=∞。

plot_grammar.legend_placement: 主图右上；inset 各自上方/上中

encodings.color: 主图映射 p；inset 映射 transition type 与 α0
encodings.line: 有限 p 为 solid；p=∞ 为 dash-dot；连接 inset 的箭头为 dotted
encodings.facet: 三个 inset 固定 a=0.4,0.7,1.2
encodings.text: 主图/inset 标题、p legend、transition-type legend、α0/αBBP 标签

figures.data_and_statistics: Analytic αBBP(a) curves for p=1,2,3,4,∞ with p*=1. The three insets show discrete p scans at fixed a; red/blue points identify transition type and red crosses are extrapolated α0 estimates from §4.2. There are no runs, error bars, intervals, or sampled uncertainty.
figures.evidence_relation: p.7 §4.1 introduces Figure 2 with “Figure 2 shows the critical ratio αBBP”, then discusses non-monotonic dependence on a, the usual decrease with p, and the near-critical exception. The dashed p=∞ curve links to Eq. (18); the α0 insets connect to Figure 4 p.9, while Appendix D Figure 6 repeats the construction for p*=2.
design_strengths: A global a sweep, fixed-a p slices, transition-type markers, and α0 estimates occupy one coherent figure.
The inset titles expose the selected slices and marker shapes distinguish αBBP points from α0 crosses.
The p=∞ limit is separated by both color and line style.
design_weaknesses: Four coordinate systems, multiple legends, thick vertical bars, and dotted arrows make the figure visually dense.
The p=1–4 identities in the main panel rely mainly on color, which weakens grayscale reading.
Main and inset y ranges differ substantially, increasing scale-switching cost.
figures.reusable_pattern: Combine a global parameter curve with fixed-slice insets to connect continuous trends, discrete choices, and auxiliary thresholds; define every color and marker in the caption.

evidence.label: Figure 2；p.7 §4.1 的主图与三个 inset

figures.label: Figure 3
figures.module: results / 4.2 Numerical Simulations and Finite N BBP Transition

caption.text: Figure 3: Comparison of BBP transitions for p = p∗ = 1. On the y axis we plot ϕ, defined as the fraction of times the eigenvector with the maximum overlap with the signal corresponds to the smallest eigenvalue. On the left a value of a for which the transition is continuous, on the right a value for which it is discontinuous. The vertical blue lines show our prediction for the BBP threshold, while for the discontinuous case the red line shows our estimate of α0.

color.semantic_mapping: 四种 N=200,400,800,1600 用蓝/橙/绿/紫曲线；左 panel 的阈值线为金色，右 panel 渲染出青色与金色竖线，legend 分别标为 αBBP 与 tilde-αBBP。图注把 discontinuous case 的估计线称为 red，渲染颜色与文字不一致。

encodings.line: 四条 solid 曲线；参考线为竖直线
encodings.text: N legend、ϕ 定义、αBBP 与辅助阈值 legend

figures.data_and_statistics: ϕ is the finite-N fraction of simulations in which the eigenvector with maximum signal overlap is also the smallest eigenvalue. Curves vary N=200,400,800,1600 and a=0.6/1.5; the paper does not report the number of repetitions per α, seeds, or uncertainty for the frequency.
figures.evidence_relation: p.8 §4.2 defines the count “the number of times the eigenvalue associated to the eigenvector with maximum overlap ... is the smallest” and introduces ϕ. Figure 3 compares that frequency with theoretical αBBP and an auxiliary threshold; the following paragraph invokes N^-2/3 versus 1/log(N) edge effects to explain the right-panel anticipation. Figure 4 continues with α0.
design_strengths: The same frequency metric and axes support a direct continuous/discontinuous comparison.
Multiple N curves visibly expose finite-size behavior around the vertical theoretical lines.
The caption defines ϕ and the reference-line roles.
design_weaknesses: N series use color without marker or line-style redundancy, limiting grayscale interpretation.
The right panel has multiple threshold lines whose semantics depend on the legend, and its caption calls the discontinuous estimate red although the rendered lines are cyan/gold.
No repetition count or frequency uncertainty is supplied, so point-to-point variation cannot be audited.
figures.reusable_pattern: Overlay theoretical reference lines on finite-size curves in matched regime panels, and define the frequency denominator, repetitions, and uncertainty computation in the caption.

figures.label: Figure 4
figures.module: results / 4.2 Numerical Simulations and Finite N BBP Transition

caption.text: Figure 4: αBBP (solid) and α0 (crosses) for two different values of p as a function of a.

color.semantic_mapping: 绿色/红色实线分别表示 p=2/3 的 αBBP，绿色/红色叉号表示对应 α0；inset 蓝/红竖线表示 α0/αBBP，黑色横向标记的语义未在图注给出。

plot_grammar.legend_placement: 主图右下；inset 无 boxed legend、使用 direct text

encodings.color: p=2/3 与 α0/αBBP 的颜色
encodings.shape: 圆点=inset m²；叉号=主图 α0
encodings.line: solid=αBBP；dash-dot=参考阈值；inset fit 为 solid
encodings.facet: 主图与 inset；inset 放大 α0 extraction
encodings.text: main legend；inset 直接标注 α0 与 αBBP

figures.data_and_statistics: Main panel plots analytic αBBP(a) for p=2,3 and discrete α0 estimates obtained by linearly extrapolating m². The inset shows m² points, a fitted line, and α0/αBBP vertical references. The fit interval, repetition count, and uncertainty are not reported; unexplained short black horizontal marks are visible near the main crosses.
figures.evidence_relation: p.9 §4.2 states “perform a linear fit and obtain α0 from the intersection of its extrapolation to lower α”; the inset visualizes that extraction. The text then positions α0 below discontinuous αBBP and as a lower bound for the finite-N empirical transition, linking Figure 4 to Figure 3 right and Figure 2 insets.
design_strengths: The extraction inset makes the origin of α0 visible instead of presenting it only as a final marker.
Theoretical αBBP curves and extrapolated α0 values share the main coordinate system for p=2,3.
Color, solid/cross marker, and inset labels provide several semantic cues.
design_weaknesses: The caption does not explain the inset, the two colors, or the visible black horizontal marks near crosses.
Fit range, uncertainty, and the conjectural lower-bound status of α0 are absent from the visual encoding.
The inset is small relative to the main panel and requires the surrounding paragraph for interpretation.
figures.reusable_pattern: Place an extraction inset inside the main threshold plot, showing auxiliary points, fit, and reference locations together; state fit range, aggregation, and inferential boundary in the caption.

figures.label: Figure 5
figures.module: appendix B / Analytical Computations for the BBP

caption.text: Figure 5: In Panel 5a, a continuous BBP is shown: the αBBP corresponds to the crossing of the g∗(α) and g−(α) curves. In Panel 5b, a discontinuous BBP is shown: the αBBP corresponds to the crossing of the g∗(α) and gmin(α) curves.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝/橙/绿实线分别为 g−(α)、g*(α)、gmin；红色虚线为 αBBP。

encodings.color: 颜色映射 g−、g*、gmin 与 αBBP

figures.data_and_statistics: Analytic g−(α), g*(α), and gmin curves with the αBBP crossing; panel (a) uses p=1 and panel (b) p=2, with p*=1,a=1. No sampling, uncertainty, or empirical aggregation is present.
figures.evidence_relation: p.21 Appendix B says “either type of transition can occur, as illustrated in Figure 5” after Eqs. (45)–(50). Panel (a) visualizes g* crossing g− for the continuous case; panel (b) visualizes g* crossing gmin for the discontinuous case, grounding Figure 1’s transition shapes in the edge equations.
design_strengths: The same function colors and legend contract make the two crossing mechanisms directly comparable.
The caption states the crossing condition for each regime.
A paired panel translates an abstract edge criterion into visible geometry.
design_weaknesses: The narrow y ranges and near-overlapping curves make crossing locations sensitive to raster size.
The roles of g−, g*, and gmin require the Appendix B derivation for physical interpretation.
Series identities depend primarily on color.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use aligned paired crossing diagrams for alternative mathematical mechanisms, keep function colors fixed, and state the crossing rule in the caption.

evidence.label: Figure 5；p.21 Appendix B 的双 panel

figures.label: Figure 6
figures.module: appendix D / Dependency on p* and Underparametrization

caption.text: Figure 6: αBBP as a function of a for p∗ = 2 for various values of p. In the inset we show αBBP as a function of p for a fixed value of a = 0.5

color.semantic_mapping: 主图颜色映射 p=1,2,3,4,∞；inset 红色圆点显示固定 a=0.5 下的 αBBP。黑色 dash-dot 对应 p=∞。

plot_grammar.legend_placement: 主图右下；inset 无独立 boxed legend

encodings.color: 颜色映射 p；inset 单色红点为切片结果
encodings.text: 主图 legend、inset 标题 a=0.5

figures.data_and_statistics: Analytic αBBP(a) curves at p*=2 for p=1,2,3,4,∞; the inset gives αBBP versus p for a=0.5 and p=1–5. The red vertical line/arrow selects the inset slice; it is not an uncertainty or inferential reference. No sampling uncertainty is shown.
figures.evidence_relation: p.23 Appendix D introduces Figure 6 as “the equivalent of figure 2 for p*=2” and states that the selected p values show a decreasing threshold while larger-p monotonicity is not expected to be guaranteed. Figure 6 extends Figure 2’s teacher-width setting and pairs with Figure 7’s p* sweep.
design_strengths: The Figure 2 global-curve/inset contract is reused, lowering the cost of reading the p*=2 extension.
The red slice line and dotted arrow make the inset’s fixed-a selection visible.
The main panel and inset expose both continuous a behavior and discrete p comparisons.
design_weaknesses: The large y range compresses low-p curves near the bottom of the main panel.
Finite-p identities rely mostly on color; only p=∞ adds a line-style cue.
The caption omits the slice marker/arrow semantics and the stated monotonicity boundary.
figures.reusable_pattern: When adding a parameter dimension, reuse the global-curve plus fixed-slice inset contract and connect the slice location back to the main axis with an explicit arrow.

figures.label: Figure 7
figures.module: appendix D / Dependency on p* and Underparametrization

caption.text: Figure 7: αBBP as a function of p∗ for p = 1 and a = 0.7

color.semantic_mapping: 单一红色圆点系列表示固定 p=1,a=0.7 下的 αBBP；颜色不承担跨系列区分。

encodings.x: p*（离散整数，按线性位置绘制）

figures.data_and_statistics: Six analytic points for αBBP(p*) at fixed student width p=1 and a=0.7, with p*=1–6. No connecting interpolation, uncertainty, repetitions, or empirical values are shown.
figures.evidence_relation: p.24 Appendix D says it explores underparametrization by keeping a and p fixed and plotting αBBP as a function of p*, then observes that αBBP increases. Figure 7 is the teacher-width slice complement to Figure 6 and carries no finite-N or dynamics evidence.
design_strengths: A single discrete series makes the p*–threshold direction quickly scannable.
The six points preserve the sampled parameter values without adding an unsupported smooth curve.
The fixed p and a conditions are stated in the caption.
design_weaknesses: The legend repeats p=1 from the title and adds little decoding value.
The y-axis extends to about 60, compressing the low-p* differences near the baseline.
Caption omits the observed monotonic trend, applicability range, and any uncertainty/status qualifier.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a minimal scatter plot for a single theoretical parameter sweep, state fixed conditions in the caption, and keep discrete points discrete.

evidence.label: Figure 7；p.24 Appendix D 顶部居中图

figures.label: Figure 8
figures.module: appendix E / Extension to Other Non-linearities

caption.text: Figure 8: Overlap between smallest eigenvector of the Hessian and the true signal as a function of α for a sigmoid activation function (left) and for the tanh activation function (right). For the sigmoid activation a = 1, while to avoid the divergence of the denominator in the tanh case we set a = 50. Points are averaged over nruns = 60 runs.

color.semantic_mapping: 每个 panel 的蓝/橙实线区分 N；对应浅蓝/浅橙 band 显示有限-run 的 dispersion，但统计定义未给出；panel 标题映射 sigmoid/tanh。

encodings.color: 颜色映射 N；panel 标题映射 activation
encodings.shape: 无 marker；band 为不确定性/离散度区域

figures.data_and_statistics: Overlap m of the Hessian smallest eigenvector with the teacher signal, averaged over nruns=60 at each point. Left uses sigmoid a=1 with N=500,1500; right uses tanh a=50 with N=500,1000; p=3,p*=1. The band statistic, seed aggregation, and raw run distribution are unspecified.
figures.evidence_relation: p.24 Appendix E introduces Figure 8 after stating that a complete nonlinear derivation is beyond scope; it supplies qualitative evidence that an outlier correlated with the teacher appears for sigmoid and tanh. The parameter explanation in the preceding text fixes p*=1,p=3 and the two a values. This is an extension claim, not a replacement for the quadratic analytic threshold.
design_strengths: Matched activation panels share metric, axes, and N color roles.
The shaded regions make finite-run dispersion visible and the caption records 60-run averaging.
The tanh parameter choice is tied to the denominator-divergence issue in the caption.
design_weaknesses: The band is visible but its SD/SE/range/quantile meaning is absent.
N identity relies on color, and no null baseline or theoretical reference line is provided.
The visual can suggest general theoretical closure even though Appendix E explicitly limits the result to qualitative similarity.
figures.reusable_pattern: Compare model or activation variants in matched panels with consistent series colors; define run aggregation and band statistic whenever a shaded region is shown.

evidence.label: Figure 8；p.24 Appendix E 下部双 panel

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: Maximum squared magnetization m² vs. α for a = 0.1. The BBP transition at intialization correlates with the onset of weak recovery.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝/红/绿实线与圆点分别表示 N=256,512,1024；黑色 dashed 竖线为 panel-specific αBBP。

plot_grammar.legend_placement: 各 panel 独立 legend；p=1 左上，其余多在右下

figures.data_and_statistics: Appendix F describes 20,000 gradient-descent steps with learning rate chosen for an average initial update of order 0.1. Each panel plots maximum student–teacher squared overlap/magnetization after dynamics versus α for N=256,512,1024; black error bars are visible, but their statistic, repetitions, seeds, and aggregation level are absent.
figures.evidence_relation: p.25 Appendix F defines the maximum overlap proxy after explaining condensation, then states that Figures 9 and 10 show the initialization BBP transition correlating with the onset of better-than-random dynamics. Figure 9 is the a=0.1 continuous regime; the text preserves the boundary that the threshold-state BBP remains unknown.
design_strengths: A fixed 2×2 small-multiple contract keeps y scales, N colors, and threshold references comparable across p.
Each panel places dynamic curves, error bars, and αBBP on one visual decision surface.
Panel-local legends expose the numeric αBBP values.
design_weaknesses: Small panels and tiny legend text make error bars and values difficult to audit.
N series have no marker/line-style redundancy, while legend positions change across panels.
The caption omits steps, N/p layout, error definition, and repetitions, so correlation cannot be read as a fully identified dynamic threshold.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use aligned small multiples for p/N dynamics with a common y scale and reference line; put optimization endpoint, repetitions, and error aggregation in the caption.

evidence.label: Figure 9；p.25 Appendix F 下半部 2×2 向量图

figures.label: Figure 10

caption.text: Figure 10: Maximum squared magnetization m² vs. α for a = 2.0. Also in the discontinuous case, the BBP transition correlates with the onset of weak recovery.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝/红/绿实线与圆点分别表示 N=256,512,1024；黑色 dashed 竖线为各 p panel 的 αBBP。

plot_grammar.legend_placement: 各 panel 独立 legend；p=1,2 左上，p=3,4 右下

figures.data_and_statistics: As in Figure 9, the plotted endpoint follows 20,000 gradient-descent steps and uses the maximum student–teacher squared magnetization. Here a=2.0 is the discontinuous regime; panels vary p=1,2,3,4 and curves vary N=256,512,1024. Error-bar statistic, repetitions, seeds, and aggregation are not defined.
figures.evidence_relation: p.25 Appendix F selects a=2.0 as the discontinuous setting and presents Figures 9–10 as preliminary evidence for alignment between initialization BBP and weak-recovery onset. Figure 10 p.26 repeats that claim for the discontinuous case while the text keeps the threshold-state BBP as an open problem.
design_strengths: Figure 10 reuses Figure 9’s panel, color, axis, and legend grammar, allowing transition-type comparison without relearning the plot.
The panel-specific αBBP values and reference lines remain visible beside the dynamic curves.
The discontinuous regime’s onset and N dependence are shown across four p values.
design_weaknesses: Error bars, dashed thresholds, and legend values compete for space in the small panels.
Color remains the only N-series identity cue, with no shape or line-style redundancy.
The caption states correlation but leaves the statistical boundary and uncertainty definition implicit.
figures.reusable_pattern: For regime comparisons, preserve the same small-multiple contract and change only the regime parameter; state threshold values, error definitions, and correlation limits in the caption.

evidence.label: Figure 10；p.26 Appendix F 上部 2×2 向量图

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: 正文 Figure 1–4 依次给出 continuous/discontinuous 理论形状、a/p 阈值全景、finite-N 频率和 α0 extraction；Appendix B Figure 5 解释 g-crossing，Appendix D Figures 6–7 扩展 p* 与 underparameterization，Appendix E Figure 8 扩展 activation，Appendix F Figures 9–10 连接 dynamics。主线为理论机制→参数趋势→有限尺寸观测→边界与动态扩展。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 10 个图注均以普通字重 Figure n: 开头，未使用粗体结论标题。Figures 2、3、5 的 encoding/crossing 说明较完整；Figures 4、6、7、9、10 偏标题与设置；Figure 8 报告 60 runs 但未定义 band；Figures 9–10 报告 correlation 但未给 error-bar 聚合或重复数。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: PDF p.1–26 没有 Table 对象，因此不存在可审计的表头层级、row group、规则、精度或高亮系统；结果信息全部由 Figure 承载。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: 正文公式 (1)–(18) 定义 teacher–student、Hessian、overlap 和 BBP crossing；Figures 1–4 将解析结果接到 finite-N 观测，Figures 5–8 给出 edge、p* 与 activation 扩展，Figures 9–10 给出 dynamics 关联。论文没有组件消融 Figure；Figures 6–10 应标为 robustness/qualitative extension，而非 ablation。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Figure 1–4 在正文 p.6–9；Appendix B Figure 5 回收 transition type 的 edge crossing；Appendix D Figures 6–7 检查 p* 与 underparameterization；Appendix E Figure 8 给出非线性定性扩展；Appendix F Figures 9–10 给出 preliminary dynamics。Appendix A 是主要推导背景，但没有额外 Figure/Table。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文和图注的 PDF 字体以 NimbusRomNo9L/Computer Modern 为主；Figures 1–8 的 raster 内部标签约 5–11 pt，Figures 9–10 的向量 small multiples 约 4.5–9 pt。图内字体与 caption 字体有 raster/vector 分层，前 8 图也没有公开源文件证明共享 rcParams。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 共同的白底、黑轴和浅灰网格保持了基础一致性；系列颜色的语义在图之间改变，且多系列对象依赖颜色。只有少数 p=∞/阈值/marker 使用线型或形状冗余；整体灰度安全性有限。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 1 的同轴双 panel：保持 estimand 和尺度不变，直接呈现两种机制形状。
Figure 2/6 的全局曲线加 fixed-slice inset：在同一图内连接参数趋势、离散选择和辅助阈值。
Figure 4 的 extraction inset：同步展示 m²、拟合线、参考线和最终 α0。
Figure 9/10 的固定坐标 2×2 small multiples：用同一 panel 合同对照 p、N 和 transition regime。
Figure 5 的 paired crossing diagram：以一致颜色把 edge 判据落到可见几何 crossing。
highest_value_objects: Figure 2：连接 a、p、transition type、p=∞ 极限和 α0 切片，是 overparameterization 主张的视觉枢纽。
Figure 3：在同一坐标面比较 large-N 阈值和 finite-N 频率，直接承载有限尺寸差异。
Figure 4：展示 α0 的外推路径，补足 Figure 3 只显示经验提前位置的缺口。
Figure 5：最清楚地解释 Figure 1 continuous/discontinuous 差异背后的 g-crossing 机制。
Figures 9–10：在“preliminary correlation”边界内对照静态初始化指标与动态 onset。
failure_patterns: Figure 1–8 没有公开绘图源；高原生 ppi 不能替代可复用的字体、rcParams、颜色和原始数据。
Figure 2、3、6、9、10 的多系列主要靠颜色，缺少稳定的 marker/线型冗余；跨图也没有全局颜色合同。
Figure 4 黑色横向标记、Figure 8 band、Figure 9–10 error bars 缺少统计定义。
Figure 4、6、7、9、10 的 caption 主要是标题/设置，参考线、适用边界和主要解释依赖正文或 legend。
Figure 9–10 的 panel 和 legend 字号很小；Figure 7 的单系列 legend 又重复标题，存在密度与冗余并存。
PDF 没有 Table，性能、成本、失败和不确定性没有表格决策面。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 以同轴理论对照和参数全景建立 BBP transition 主线，再用 finite-N、edge crossing、teacher-width、activation 与 dynamics 的小 multiples 逐层扩展，但整体依赖颜色、未公开绘图源和未定义的不确定性编码。
